574-7084-8338.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-7084-8338.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

3532-5078-6607-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1477-1643-2073-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

129-1409-1879-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-6478-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-6478-6965.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

969-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
969-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
969-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1018-3378-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
1018-3378-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Skullwinder and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Skullwinder and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1018-3378-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

4693-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1903-3490-3755-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1903-3490-3755-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1169-2463-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-2463-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4771-5220-6559-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

856-2267-3899-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2267-3899-4321.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

580-1879-2034-4364-5003.description:
Declare Aurelia and Savior of Ollenbock as attackers, triggering Aurelia and Savior of Ollenbock's training ability.
Resolve the Aurelia trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aurelia, adding {C}{C}.
If Aurelia is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone.
When Aurelia dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Resolve the Savior of Ollenbock trigger from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Savior of Ollenbock's second ability triggers, exiling Aurelia from your graveyard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Savior of Ollenbock, adding {C}{C}.
When Savior of Ollenbock dies, its third ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Savior of Ollenbock trigger, returning Aurelia from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Savior of Ollenbock from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat each combat phase.

3484-3921-4365-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3484-3921-4365-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1879-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1879-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

710-4775-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Danitha's power.
Repeat.

1069-3480-3552-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3480-3552-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

333-2730-5231.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2730-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos, adding {R}.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Lotus Field.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Lotus Field.
Repeat.
74-943-3664.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Lotus Field instead.

2773-4133-5231.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Soul Collector, adding {R}.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-3529-4231-4264.notablePrerequisites:
Altered Ego is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-4231-4264.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1110-1823-2864-5231.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature with toughness six or less.
You do not control an Army.
1110-1823-2864-5231.description:
Activate That Which Was Taken by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a divinity counter on a creature an opponent controls with toughness six or less.
Activate Fall of Cair Andros by paying {7}{R}, dealing seven damage to the creature that has a divinity counter on it.
Fall of Cair Andros triggers, creating a 0/0 Army and putting at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Army enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers.
Holding priority, Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Army, adding {R}.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage to the creature with a divinity counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite red mana, with a Terror of the Peaks trigger on the stack, you may use Fall of Cair Andros' ability to deal infinite damage to the creature with a divinity counter on it, thus causing the Army to have infinite +1/+1 counters on it, which causes Terror of the Peaks to deal infinite damage to any target.

413-678-3661.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Shield Sphere to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2021-2060-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Crystalline Crawler.
2021-2060-4222.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, putting a growth counter on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat until Simic Ascendancy has at least twenty growth counters on it.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's third ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

1495-2919.notablePrerequisites:
Triskelion has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a way to give Triskelion lifelink.
1495-2919.description:
Give Triskelion lifelink.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-2532-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Jaxis.
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
You have at least one card in hand.
2178-2532-4050.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the copy, adding {R}.
The creature dies, triggering itself and Jaxis.
Resolve the creature's trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Jaxis trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

302-678-4465.description:
Sacrifice Mindlash Sliver to its ability, adding {B}{B}.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Mindlash Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Mindlash Sliver.
Repeat.

1671-3525-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Ley Druid.
1671-3525-4348.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.

2724-4006-4428.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Thassa. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
